# VARKORA

> VARKORA is operations software for construction, logistics and real estate companies, bringing projects, shipments, documents and finances into one configurable, mobile-first platform. A venture by RAZZO and Sotres.

## Solutions

- VARKORA Construction: leads, estimates, crews, inspections and billing in one place, with a client portal.
- VARKORA Logistics: material orders, shipments, customs and cross-border distribution, with finances and demand-based planning.
- VARKORA Real Estate: assets, assessments, capital plans and owner reporting.

## Platform

One connected data model for sales, operations and finance; built-in analytics; AI agents and automations with permissions, limits and human review; data pipelines between departments; role-based access, encryption in transit and at rest, activity logs and automatic backups; migration of existing spreadsheets and files, with export to Excel or CSV; connections to the ERP, accounting and e-commerce systems that stay; mobile-first access with agent alerts and approvals from the phone.

## How it works

Discovery call (20 minutes, free), Discovery Sprint (1 to 2 weeks, fixed price, credited to the project), implementation priced by scope, then an annual subscription with support and updates. VARKORA licenses the platform; client business data stays with the client and is exportable.
